Tucson, Arizona · coffee

Coffee in Tucson for cyclists

Where riders in Tucson start the day and finish the ride. Open early, near the routes, fine with a table of people in bibs. The ones marked ride-out sit at a group ride’s start; the note says which ride and when.

For: El Tour de Tucson.

Coffee in Tucson for cyclists, listed

  1. LeBuzz Caffe (Tanque Verde)

    9121 E Tanque Verde Rd, Tucson, AZ · 6 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily

    ride-out

    At Tanque Verde Road and the Catalina Highway, the road up Mount Lemmon, about 11 miles northeast of downtown and 4.5 miles from mile marker 0. Opens at 6 every day, so it is the coffee before the climb, and the lot Bike Mount Lemmon points drivers to. Cactus Cycling Club’s Saguaro East ride (Fridays, 7:30 am) leaves from La Herradura on the same road and stops here after. Nothing says bike parking. (520) 749-3903.

    The ride from here: Friday Saguaro East Ride (Fridays, 7:30 am) →

  2. Presta Coffee Roasters (Mercado San Agustín)

    100 S Avenida del Convento, Tucson, AZ 85745 · 7 a.m. to 2 p.m. daily

    ride-out

    Inside the Mercado San Agustín on the west side, less than half a mile from where the Loop crosses Congress Street, where the Women’s Shootout (Saturdays, 7:15 am) meets. Opens at 7, per the Mercado’s directory, so it is the coffee before or after depending on the ride’s start that week. Bar and patio seating, per Presta. Nothing says bike parking. Seis Kitchen is in the same courtyard and Transit Cycles is in the MSA Annex on the same street.

    The ride from here: Women’s Shootout Tucson (Saturdays, 7:15 am) →

  3. Ren Coffeehouse

    4300 N Campbell Ave, Suite 24, Tucson, AZ · 6 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily

    ride-out

    In St. Philip’s Plaza at River and Campbell, off the Rillito stretch of the Loop. The plaza’s south lot is one of the two starts of GABA’s NW social rides (Some Thursdays and Saturdays, 7:00 am), which end with coffee at Ren’s or at Bruegger’s in Oro Valley; the post for each ride says which start. Opens at 6 every day, with an outdoor patio, per its site. Nothing says bike parking. (520) 638-6290.

    The ride from here: GABA NW Social Rides (Some Thursdays and Saturdays, 7:00 am) →

  4. Bruegger’s Bagels (La Cañada)

    11165 N La Canada Dr, Suite 161, Tucson, AZ 85737 · 5:30 a.m. daily; closes 4 p.m., 3 p.m. Sunday

    ride-out

    On the north side, about 13 miles north of downtown, where Cactus Cycling Club’s Oro Valley ride (Wednesdays, 8:00 am) leaves; the lot south of the shop is the other start of GABA’s NW social rides (Some Thursdays and Saturdays, 7:00 am). Opens at 5:30 every day, the earliest door on this list. A chain bagel shop; nothing on its page says bike parking or a patio.

    The ride from here: Wednesday Oro Valley Ride (Wednesdays, 8:00 am); GABA NW Social Rides (Some Thursdays and Saturdays, 7:00 am) →

  5. Time Market

    444 E University Blvd, Tucson, AZ 85705 · 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily

    On University Boulevard, a few blocks west of the corner where the Shootout (Saturdays, 7:00 am) and the Tuesday Morning Fast Ride (Tuesdays, 7:00 am) leave. Opens at 7 every day, with bread baked in-house each morning and a patio, per its site, so it is the sure coffee after. It serves breakfast to dinner and stays open till 10. No ride names it as a meet. 520-622-0761.

  6. Mt. Lemmon Cookie Cabin

    12781 N Sabino Canyon Park, Mt Lemmon, AZ 85619 · 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. daily

    In Summerhaven near the top of the Mount Lemmon climb, at 8,000 feet: big cookies, New York-style pizza and drinks, per its site. It opens at 11, so an early climb gets there first; the Mt. Lemmon General Store on the same road opens at 10 with warm drinks and snacks, per the store’s site. The Cabin says to check Google Maps for closures. 520-576-1010.
